name: All stateful data MUST be backed up to a separate region/location (Immutable backups preferred) to ensure all systems and data can be recovered after a major attack or disaster.
conditionsText: Definitely services that use cloud storage, I am not sure if we have any on-prem legacy services and what the rules would be for that
requirementTitle: All stateful data MUST be backed up to a separate region/location (Immutable backups preferred) to ensure all systems and data can be recovered after a major attack or disaster.
requirementDescription: Any data that changes and needs to be retained must be backed up, and those backups must be stored somewhere separate from the primary system. Ideally, the backups should be immutable (cannot be changed or deleted) so they can still be recovered after a ransomware attack or major outage.
why: The goal is to ensure the service can recover from ransomware, accidental deletion, corruption, or a major disaster.
